description:
SAIC is seeking a Software Engineer to support advanced Very Low Frequency (VLF) communication systems. Join our innovative team in San Diego, CA, and contribute to mission-critical efforts in communication technology development, integration, and testing.
  The candidate will have a strong background in system software engineering support, preferably with DoD Development programs, and possess a strong problem solving skill. Qualified candidates will have in-depth experience and the ability to learn new technologies quickly. 
 This is an Onsite role in San Diego, CA and requires up to 10% of travel throughout the year. 
 JOB DUTIES: 
 Development and updates of RF communications systems. 
 Supporting VLF for communications for Navy and Air Force
 Experience with the testing, configuration and documentation of Software Systems and hardware systems
 Work in conjunction with Software Developers to develop and implement test procedures and scenarios for new and updated systems
 Participate in resolving technical issues and troubleshoot the system that may arise during integration, implementation and test
 Provide technical direction, guidance and training to less experienced staff
 Interface with management, customers and team regularly
 
 

 REQUIREMENTS :
 Bachelors in related engineering field or in a related science or mathematics field and two (2) years or more experience; Masters and 0 years related experience. 
 Must have an Active Secret Clearance to start
 Must be able to obtain a Top Secret Clearance after start
 DoD IAT 1 certified eligible.  Security+ (able to obtain within 6 months of hire)
 2 Years’ development and engineering experience with C, C++, and Java programming
 Strong skills in establishing equipment configurations to meet operational requirements.
 Exceptional communication and problem-solving skills.
 A demonstrated ability to learn and apply new technologies quickly.
  
 DESIRED SKILLS: 
 Background in RF Engineering, with preferred experience in VLF systems.
 Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, including Visio, Project, Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint, and Word.

 
 
 SAIC®  is a premier mission integrator focused on advancing the power of technology and innovation to serve and protect our world. Our robust portfolio of offerings across the defense, space, intelligence, and civilian markets includes secure high-end solutions in mission IT, enterprise IT, engineering services, and professional services. We integrate emerging technology, rapidly and securely, into mission critical operations that modernize and enable critical national imperatives. 
 
 

 We are approximately 23,000 strong; driven by mission, united by purpose, and inspired by opportunities. SAIC is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Headquartered in Reston, Virginia, SAIC has annual revenues of approximately $7.3 billion. For more information, visit  saic.com . For ongoing news, please visit our  newsroom .
